candidate_merges.message: fix(ci): Fix internal build (#21774) ## Description Automatic main builds fail in the `Assemble + Publish` stage, during the `🟣Verify NuGet package signatures` step: ```text ##[section]Starting: 🟣Verify NuGet package signatures Verifying signatures for 158 NuGet release packages. Verifying Aspire.AppHost.Sdk.17.0.0-preview.1.26553.7 error: NU3004: The package is not signed. Package signature validation failed. ##[error]PowerShell exited with code '1'. ``` The NuGet verifier checks for real signi

Order Team App Needs attention by first readiness (#21726) ## Description The Aspire Team App's Needs attention section helps the team decide whose work to unblock next. It currently puts the most recently updated PRs first, can order equal timestamps by fetch completion, and uses a column-first layout that looks different at different widths. This changes Needs attention to a numbered, row-major queue ordered by **first-ever non-draft readiness**, oldest first: creation time for PRs opened read
